title: BOSS DR12 selected mock formats and current estimator requirements

scopes.title: Mock lineage, estimator conventions and joint P/B conditioning
scopes.checked_claim: Selected CMASS/NGC power-mock headers declare catalogue/random ancestry, processing choices and seven output fields. Selected bispectrum first records have seven fields, distinct from the eleven-field current BRASS parser/RUSTICO writer. Current code exposes catalogue-weight, shot-noise, random-window LOS/normalization and joint-vector covariance choices; these are conditional implementation requirements. The RR-mask writer puts bin center before pair-mean separation despite opposite literal header labels.
scopes.unresolved: Physical paired realization/reconstruction identity, exact historical implementation/configuration, full row/grid/triangle order, B/mask adaptation, estimator calibration and complete survey-window/covariance/likelihood ancestry remain open. Equal mock counts do not certify paired valid ID sets. Shared galaxies/mocks/geometry and unknown cross-covariance prevent independent amplitude interpretation.

limitations: The pinned current RUSTICO/BRASS sources and author-linked mock release are distinct assets from the historical 2017 analysis. README dates, repository timestamps and download metadata do not establish the historical implementation, parameter file or exact output ancestry.

Equal filename suffixes and archive counts do not establish physical paired realizations or reconstruction identity. The earlier author-page post-reconstruction B-mock label conflicts with the pre-reconstruction notes/data description; selected headerless B records do not resolve it.

Only two power headers and two bispectrum first records were examined. Full grids, triangle ordering, all rows, missing-record behavior, all mock IDs and common valid realization sets remain unchecked.

The selected B records use seven fields while the current BRASS B reader expects eleven. The current seven-field RR-mask output is distinct from the older six-field released squared-moment mask. A verified adapter and exact convention/normalization mapping are required; no implicit conversion is accepted.

The current cut-sky parser, shot-noise options, random weights, density conventions, mask LOS and normalization choices require an exact selected configuration and data ancestry. No full bispectrum survey-window closure or historical window application has been established.

A complete paired P0/P2/B0 vector, all auto/cross covariance blocks, exact selection/bin order, finite-mock correction and likelihood law remain unqualified. Separate source counters with equal totals do not prove paired valid ID sets; unknown cross-covariance is not zero.

BOSS fitted fσ8 remains a conditioned summary with shared galaxies, mocks, BAO geometry and unknown external cross-covariance. Neither current model options nor header effective redshifts establish an independent observation or an ordinary σ8 prediction at a declared epoch with full-k 8 h^-1 Mpc top-hat support and compatible matter/species physics.

Historical printed AP/likelihood issues and earlier release-note ambiguities remain separately preserved. Current code does not resolve them or reproduce the historical source outputs. Public access and null licence metadata do not establish redistribution permission.

Current RR normalization semantics require a valid nonzero W0 denominator and valid pair-mean bins. The selected fallback search does not certify those conditions or a refusal outside them; no observed validity or guard qualification is inferred.
